title: Age of students
statementMd:
Show each student's age in whole years as of 2024-09-01. List the five oldest (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `age`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, CAST((julianday('2024-09-01') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age FROM students ORDER BY age DESC, name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
